title: Three bricks charts on the live index card
goal: The card shows the coordinator's figures as charts
acceptance: Records per status (donut), open steps per repository by status (stacked bar) and merged PRs per day or week (bar or line), mapped from the coordinator's MCP read tools (coordinator:F-024-T04) in src/ with unit tests
The surface card renders them with the bricks release that has the charts (bricks:F-014-T07); a figure the tools do not serve is recorded as a coordinator request, not computed here
Browser test: the charts and their data tables render in light and dark
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Three mappings and a card layout on top of F-147. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
